Game Overview

Pong Day puts players into a retro experience centered on relive arcade glory in Pong Day, where precision and timing are crucial. Face off against a cunning CPU or challenge friends in swift, exhilarating duels. Master paddle control, anticipate the ball's path, and let your reflexes shine. This high-energy throwback promises endless competitive fun!
